names.note: The name as days.pravoslavie.ru's name page 14271 gives it, «Рафаил (Шейченко), иеромонах, исповедник», with the grade and the rank word taken off. Measured with the gate's own fold before it was written: 'рафаил шейченко' has no other holder. The day line prints the bare forename «Рафаила» in the genitive, so the surname is read off the name link; it stays in the parentheses the calendar itself prints. A `grep -rl` for «Шейченко» over the corpus returned nothing.

death.note: The year the day line gives him: «Прп. Рафаила исп (1957).» — where the line's «исп» is printed without its full stop. The name page gives no year of birth and no day within 1957.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 6 июня ст. ст. — «Прп. Рафаила исп (1957).»

attestations.note: The day's seventh entry of eight, «Прп. Рафаила исп (1957).», the abbreviation «исп» printed without its full stop. Name page 14271 heads him «Рафаил (Шейченко), иеромонах, исповедник» and lists THREE days, «26 января (Новомуч.) , 6 июня , 9 июня (обретение мощеи)» — the third labelled by the source itself as the finding of his relics. **The row is on 6 июня, the day whose page prints him; the 9 июня relics day is not a second feast to record here and the Julian 9 June has not been read yet**, so when it is, this folder wants a `feast.note` and not a moved row. He is исповедник and NOT новомученик: the calendar grades him a confessor and not a martyr, which is why `new-martyr` is not in `types` although the «26 января (Новомуч.)» day stands on his page as it does on every twentieth-century entry's. Иеромонах is `hieromonk` in `types` and the `office` is the bare `Priest` the locale packs carry. There is no /Life/ page for him. The name page links articles on Pravoslavie.Ru — the one it names is by Ксения Орабей, on what he called the most needful ware in life — **and NOT ONE WORD of any of them was read**; the name page prints no teaser of its opening the way Михаил (Вотяков)'s does. So this folder rests on the day line and on the name page's heading and days, and on nothing else. `ls -d saints/raphael*` returned seven folders, all other men, and the day page prints no hymn under his name. azbyka.ru was not read.
